topic: Sorting Out First-Day Paperwork with HR

script.title: FIRST DAY AT HR
script.scene_zh: 人力資源辦公室 · 入職報到
script.story_hook: One folder of forms stands between him and day one.
script.intro_zh: 一疊表格，擋在他與第一天上班之間。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to a very first day on the job. Listen for paperwork phrases you'll need too.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到第一天上班的場景。也留意你同樣會用到的報到說法。
script.outro: And that's day one, fully signed and sealed. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 第一天就這樣簽好、蓋章、報到完成。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a nervous young man in his early twenties with messy sandy hair, wire-frame glasses, a wrinkled light blue button-down shirt, an oversized navy blazer, and a lanky build
script.char_b_description: a warm woman in her forties with jet black hair cut in a sharp bob, gold hoop earrings, a cream cardigan over a maroon blouse, a lanyard of ID badges, and a curvy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm Theo, the new hire. First day, um...
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm ˈθi.oʊ ðə nu haɪɚ fɝst deɪ ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是新進員工 Theo。第一天報到，嗯……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome, Theo! I'm Grace. This desk is today's station.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛl.kəm ˈθi.oʊ aɪm ɡɹeɪs ðɪs dɛsk ɪz təˈdeɪz ˈsteɪ.ʃən/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎 Theo！我是 Grace。今天這張桌子就是你的站位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Station? I thought today was only paperwork.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsteɪ.ʃən aɪ θɔt təˈdeɪ wəz ˈoʊnli ˈpeɪpɚ.wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 站位？我以為今天只有表格要填。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just paperwork, though my desk is your station.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈpeɪpɚ.wɝk ðoʊ maɪ dɛsk ɪz jɔɹ ˈsteɪ.ʃən/
dialogue.zh: 對，只是表格，不過我的桌子就是你的站位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, honestly I came prepared with a folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝ.fɪkt ˈɑ.nəst.li aɪ keɪm prɪˈpɛrd wɪð ə ˈfoʊl.dɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，老實說我有帶著文件夾來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A folder! Great start. First, this is direct deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfoʊl.dɚ ɡɹeɪt stɑɹt fɝst ðɪs ɪz dəˈrɛkt dɪˈpɑ.zɪt/
dialogue.zh: 文件夾！好開頭。第一份是薪資直接入帳表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my paycheck goes straight into my bank?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ ˈpeɪtʃ.ɛk ɡoʊz stɹeɪt ˈɪn.tu maɪ bæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 所以我的薪水會直接進到我的銀行帳戶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Bank name, routing number, account number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzækt.li bæŋk neɪm ˈru.tɪŋ ˈnʌm.bɚ əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌm.bɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。銀行名稱、路由碼、帳號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, the routing number... is that on my card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðə ˈru.tɪŋ ˈnʌm.bɚ ɪz ðət ɑn maɪ kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，路由碼……會印在我的卡上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not the card. Check a paper statement, or online.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ðə kɑɹd tʃɛk ə ˈpeɪ.pɚ ˈsteɪt.mənt ɔɹ ˌɑnˈlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 卡上沒有。去看紙對帳單，或在線上查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll message my mom after lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ.keɪ aɪl ˈmɛ.sɪdʒ maɪ mɑm ˈæf.tɚ lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好，午餐後我再傳訊息問我媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She kept statements since 1992, I bet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kɛpt ˈsteɪt.mənts sɪns ˌnaɪnˈtin ˈnɪn.ti tu aɪ bɛt/
dialogue.zh: 我猜她從 1992 年就一直在留對帳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pretty much. What's this W-two form then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɪ.ti mʌtʃ wæts ðəs ˌdʌb.əlˈju tu fɔɹm ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 差不多吧。那這張 W-2 表格是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tax withholding. Do you have more than one job?
dialogue.phonetic: /tæks ˌwɪðˈhoʊld.ɪŋ du ju hæv mɔɹ ðæn wʌn dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 所得扣繳表。你有多於一份工作嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, um, this one, plus summer tutoring.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ʌm ðɪs wʌn plʌs ˈsʌm.ɚ ˈtu.tɚ.ɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一份，嗯，正職這個，加上暑期家教。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two jobs—step two matters, mark them both.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu dʒɑbz stɛp tu ˈmæɾɚz mɑk ðɛm boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 有兩份工作，第二步很重要，兩份都標上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I pick married or single here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ pɪk ˈmɛɹ.dɪd ɔɹ ˈsɪŋ.ɡəl hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 這邊要選已婚還是單身？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Single, unless that changed in the last year?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪŋ.ɡəl ʌnˈlɛs ðət tʃeɪndʒd ɪn ðə læst jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 單身，除非過去一年有改變？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, no, my cactus is my only roommate.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ noʊ maɪ ˈkæk.təs ɪz maɪ ˈoʊnli ˈɹum.meɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，沒有，我的仙人球是我唯一的室友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tidy cactus counts as good company.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaɪ.di ˈkæk.təs kaʊnts æz ɡʊd ˈkʌm.pə.ni/
dialogue.zh: 整潔的仙人球也算是好夥伴啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, done. Is this the scary part now?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ.keɪ dʌn ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈskɛɹ.pi pɑɹt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，填完了。現在是最可怕的部分了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope. Insurance is the fun mountain, ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp ɪnˈʃɚ.əns ɪz ðə fʌn ˈmaʊn.tən ˈɹɛd.i/
dialogue.zh: 不，保險才是那座好玩的山，準備好沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fun? I might need snacks for this climb.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʌn aɪ maɪt nid snæks fɔɹ ðɪs klaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 好玩？我可能得帶點心來爬這座山。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a granola drawer, help yourself anytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɪz ə ɡɹəˈnoʊ.lə ˈdɹɔ.ɚ hɛlp jɔɹˈsɛlf ˈɛn.i.taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有抽屜裝格蘭諾拉，隨時自己拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. So what am I choosing exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs soʊ wʌt æm aɪ ˈtʃu.zɪŋ ɪɡˈzækt.li/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。所以我到底要選什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three plans: bronze, silver, or the gold tier.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi plæns bɹɑnz ˈsɪl.vɚ ɔɹ ðə ɡoʊd tɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 三種方案：青銅、白銀，或是黃金級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Silver sounds good. What's the window rule?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪl.vɚ saʊndz ɡʊd wæts ðə ˈwɪn.doʊ ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 白銀聽起來不錯。加保期限的規則是？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You must enroll within thirty days, no exceptions.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju məst ɪnˈɹoʊl wɪˈðɪn ˈθɝ.ti deɪz noʊ ɪkˈsɛp.ʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 你必須在三十天內投保，沒有例外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today counts as day one, right? Please say yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ kaʊnts æz deɪ wʌn ɹaɪt pliz seɪ jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 今天算第一天對吧？請說是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does. You're safe, we have till October.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz jʊɹ seɪf wi hæv tɪl ɑkˈtoʊ.bɚ/
dialogue.zh: 算的。你很安全，離十月還久著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, my head finally has room to think.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd maɪ hɛd ˈfaɪ.nə.li hæz ɹum tə θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 噢太好了，我腦袋終於有空間思考了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small problem, we still need your badge photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl ˈpɹɑb.ləm wi stɪl nid jɔɹ bædʒ ˈfoʊ.toʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有個小問題，還沒拍你的證件照呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right! Can I use my license photo, honestly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt kæn aɪ juz maɪ ˈlaɪ.səns ˈfoʊ.toʊ ˈɑ.nəst.li/
dialogue.zh: 對！老實說，我可以用駕照上的照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on file, but... were you asleep?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɑn faɪl bət wɜɹ ju əˈslip/
dialogue.zh: 檔案裡有，不過……你當時是在打瞌睡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! That photo was not my best day.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæt ˈfoʊ.toʊ wəz nɑt maɪ bɛst deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！那張照片確實不是我最好的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No judgment. Mine looks like a startled owl.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈdʒʌdʒ.mənt maɪn lʊks laɪk ə ˈstɚr.təld aʊl/
dialogue.zh: 不評論。我那張看起來像受驚的貓頭鷹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Do I blink? I'm blinking, am I?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs du aɪ blɪŋk aɪm ˈblɪŋ.kɪŋ æm aɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？我會眨眼嗎？我在眨眼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Freeze. Got it. Oh, the light caught your ear.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹiːz ɡɑt ɪt oʊ ðə laɪt kɑt jɔɹ ɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 別動。拍好了。噢，燈光剛照到你的耳朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bad? Do I look like a sleepy owl?
dialogue.phonetic: /bæd du aɪ lʊk laɪk ə ˈsli.pi aʊl/
dialogue.zh: 很糟嗎？我看上去會像困到不行的貓頭鷹嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's charming, honest. The printer hates ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈtʃɑɹ.mɪŋ ˈɑ.nəst ðə ˈprɪn.tɚ heɪts ɪɹz/
dialogue.zh: 很有魅力，真的。只是印表機最討厭耳朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I'll wear my hair over it then.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn aɪl wɛɹ maɪ hɛɹ ˈoʊ.vɚ ɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那我就用頭髮蓋住它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please don't. The badge needs your whole face.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz doʊnt ðə bædʒ nidz jɔɹ hoʊl feɪs/
dialogue.zh: 請別蓋。證件照要拍到整張臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. When will the badge be ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf wɛn wɪl ðə bædʒ bi ˈɹɛd.i/
dialogue.zh: 說得對。證件什麼時候會做好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday, bring a clip, we don't sell lanyards.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹaɪ.deɪ bɹɪŋ ə klɪp wi doʊnt sɛl ˈlæn.jɚdz/
dialogue.zh: 週五來拿，自備夾子，這裡不賣掛繩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I own eleven lanyards, um, career luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊn ɪˈlɛv.ən ˈlæn.jɚdz ʌm kəˈɹɪɹ lʌk/
dialogue.zh: 我擁有十一條掛繩，嗯，這算職涯運氣吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them. So, questions before I stamp these?
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm soʊ ˈkwɛs.tʃənz bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ stæmp ðiz/
dialogue.zh: 收著吧。所以，我蓋章前還有問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only one: do we eat lunch at our station?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊn.li wʌn du wi it lʌntʃ æt aʊɹ ˈsteɪ.ʃən/
dialogue.zh: 只有一個：午餐可以在站位上吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please don't. The break room has a real chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz doʊnt ðə breɪk ɹum hæz ə ɹi.tʃɛɹ tʃɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 千萬別。休息室有真正的椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted with fear. Also, where do I park?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊ.tɪd wɪð fɪɹ ˈɔl.soʊ wɛɹ du aɪ pɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 我害怕地記下了。還有，我要把車停哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Row C is ours, show your paper today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹoʊ si ɪz ɑɹz ʃoʊ jɔɹ ˈpeɪ.pɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: C 列是我們的車位，今天先出示紙本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This paperwork stack? It's basically a novel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈpeɪ.pɚ.wɝk stæk ɪts ˈbeɪ.sɪk.li ə ˈnɑ.vəl/
dialogue.zh: 這疊表格？根本是一部長小說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read twice, sign once, and bring it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹid twaɪs saɪn wʌns ænd bɹɪŋ ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 讀兩遍，簽一次，再拿回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done by two, I promise. Was the tutoring ok?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn baɪ tu aɪ ˈpɹɑ.mɪs wəz ðə ˈtu.tɚ.ɪŋ oʊ.keɪ/
dialogue.zh: 兩點前完成，我保證。那個家教沒填錯吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You marked it right, very neat, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju mɑɹkt ɪt ɹaɪt ˈvɛɹ.i nit ˈæk.tʃu.ə.li/
dialogue.zh: 你勾對了，其實寫得很整潔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: High praise from the station manager, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ pɹeɪz fɹʌm ðə ˈsteɪ.ʃən ˈmæn.ɪ.dʒɚ θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 來自站位經理的高度誇獎，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm only borrowing this desk, back to work.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈoʊn.li ˈbɑ.ɹoʊ.ɪŋ ðɪs dɛsk bæk tə wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 這桌子我也是暫借的，回去工作吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, the station. See you at two, Grace.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ðə ˈsteɪ.ʃən si ju æt tu ɡɹeɪs/
dialogue.zh: 對，站位。兩點見，Grace。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two o'clock. Bring mom's routing number, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu əˈklɑk bɹɪŋ mɑmz ˈru.tɪŋ ˈnʌm.bɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 兩點整。記得帶你媽的路由碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Best first day ever, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl bɛst fɝst deɪ ˈɛ.vɚ ˈæk.tʃu.ə.li/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。真的是歷來最好的第一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go on, before we need yet another photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɑn bɪˈfɔɹ wi nid jɛt əˈnʌð.ɚ ˈfoʊ.toʊ/
dialogue.zh: 快去吧，在還需要另一張照片之前。

script.youtube_title: 【第一天上班報到🪪】「那張照片不是我最好的一天」😅｜60句人資辦公室聽力💼🎧｜聽完不怕填表｜First Day HR Paperwork
script.youtube_title_en: "Not My Best Day" — Sorting First-Day Paperwork with HR
script.youtube_description:
「那張照片不是我最好的一天」——第一天報到，薪資要直入銀行帳戶、扣繳表要勾、保險要在三十天內加保，證件照還拍壞了？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在公司人力資源辦公室。

你會聽到：直入帳表怎麼填、路由碼去哪裡找；稅務扣繳表怎麼勾一份工作與單身；保險三種方案與三十天加保期限的問答；證件照拍壞、燈光照到耳朵這類真實小狀況，還有掛繩、停車位這些報到瑣事。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人上班族每天用的自然語感：um、okay、so、ha、honestly。聽完你就會用：direct deposit、tax withholding、enroll within thirty days、is this the scary part。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"That photo was not my best day" — on your first day, payroll goes to a bank form, taxes need a checkbox, insurance has a thirty-day window, and the badge photo just went wrong. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set in the HR office.

You will hear: filling the direct deposit form and hunting for a routing number; marking one job and single status on the tax form; choosing among three insurance plans and the enrollment window; plus real small mishaps like a bad badge photo and a light that catches your ear.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the office rhythm people use daily: um, okay, so, ha, honestly. By the end you'll own phrases like direct deposit, tax withholding, and enroll within thirty days.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.
